study: pentane R15 timestep / FR campaign (docs/PENTANE_R15_DT_FR.md): Stages B (ABF timestep convergence), C/D (ABF vs ABF + uniform mFR, pilot + confirmatory), E (analysis)
frozen_utc: 2026-10-18, before any ABF or FR dynamics of this campaign was run and before any Stage A result was read
arms_only: F = ABF + uniform-marginal Fisher-Rao birth-death (fr_uniform, target uniform on the full grid [1.4, 3.7], fr_domain None = the original project's fr_uniform)
no_other_methods: no OT / rejuvenation / OPES / metadynamics / sham arm
cell: frozen production cell of configs/alkanes_cv_extension/r15_methods.yaml (stage production): pentane, beta 2, sigma 2.3, N 1024, all-trans start, walls 1.45/3.65 k 200, grid 256 on [1.4, 3.7], ABF bandwidth 0.04, FR KDE bandwidth 0.06, ABF bias clip 60, sample clip 480, physical clip 200, score clip 2, max event fraction 0.01

physical_schedule.rule: step counts = physical time / dt (alkanes.dt_schedule.physical_schedule); fr_every = 0.0025/dt so dt_eff = dt*fr_every = 0.0025 at every dt; FR rate per unit physical time

fr_target_domain_note: With a uniform target the score is log p_hat(R_i) recentred (log q is constant on the walkers' support and the recentring removes it), so the target domain matters only for walkers outside it; with the full grid none is. No separate domain-sensitivity experiment is planned.

seeds.confirmatory: rng 20261201, 20261202, 20261203, 20261204, 4 seeds each = 16 fresh seeds; never used before

pairing: A and F with the same rng share initial states and the dynamics noise stream (gen_dyn); F's birth-death uses its own stream (gen_fr); A and F are bitwise identical before t = 6 (tested)

stage_B_pilot.purpose: (1) timestep at fixed physical time, (2) physical time at fixed dt and at equal force evaluations (dt 5e-4 T 160, dt 2.5e-4 T 80 and dt 1.25e-4 T 40 all cost 320k steps), (3) deposition frequency at fixed dt (stride runs)
stage_B_pilot.no_tuning: ABF bandwidth and every estimator parameter frozen

runs: F rate 0.02 at dt 5e-4, 2.5e-4, 1.25e-4 (T 40, rng 20261101) paired with the stage-B A runs
plus F rate 0.02 at the Stage-A-selected dt if it is 6.25e-5 (then also A at 6.25e-5)
stage_CD_pilot.purpose: broken runs, instabilities, FR activity and genealogy; not used for any selection except the pre-specified activity check

fr_rate_calibration.when: always (the 2026-09-06 campaign measured uniform FR at 0.02 as inert: 100 replacements over 13 600 opportunities)
fr_rate_calibration.runs: F only, rates 0.02, 0.05, 0.10, rng 20261102, 4 seeds, at the Stage-A-selected dt (at 5e-4 if none is validated)
fr_rate_calibration.statistics: per rate: median over seeds of total replacements / N, final ancestor ESS / N, final max ancestor fraction
fr_rate_calibration.safe: median final ancestor ESS/N >= 0.5 AND median final max ancestor fraction <= 0.05
fr_rate_calibration.active: median total replacements >= 1.0 N over the run
fr_rate_calibration.selection_rule: secondary rate = the SMALLEST rate in {0.05, 0.10} that is safe and active; if none is active, the LARGEST safe rate in {0.05, 0.10}; if none is safe, no secondary rate. Free-energy errors of the calibration runs are NOT computed before the rate is fixed.

confirmatory.runs: A, F(0.02), F(secondary) at the selected dt and at dt 5e-4 (historical), T 40, 16 fresh seeds (rng 20261201-04)

metrics.mask: v2 reference window [2.0828, 3.5383] (162 bins), the only evaluation mask
metrics.gauge: every profile centred by the mean of (F_hat - F_ref) on the window (additive-constant alignment)
metrics.e_F(t): windowed RMS L2 of the reported ABF free energy (production accumulators, kernel-smoothed mean force integrated) vs F_ref v2
metrics.e_Fp(t): windowed RMS L2 of the reported mean force vs F'_ref v2 (no alignment)
metrics.I_F: trapezoid integral of e_F over the checkpoints t = 0, 1, ..., T (physical time)
metrics.primary_effect: Delta I_F = I_F(F)/I_F(A) - 1 per paired seed; median, 95 % bootstrap CI (10 000 resamples of seeds), wins
secondary: KL(p_hat || U) of the walker marginal on the window, time-integrated over [6, T]
under-supported window fraction (final effective count < 25 % of window median)
first discovery time of each torsional family / 9 basins
family occupancy and distinct ancestors per family
family transitions and R-tercile round trips
D_cond: mean TV over the window R-bins of the deposit-weighted p(phi1, phi2 | R bin) vs the reference (48x48; bins with < 100 deposits score 1)
ancestor ESS / N and max ancestor fraction
replacements, score magnitude, birth/death R histograms
metrics.budget_axes: equal physical time (primary) and equal force evaluations (1024 per step; FR adds none); wall-clock reported

classification_rules.A_numerical_rescue: Stage A FAILS dt 5e-4 (D > tolerance) AND, on the confirmatory seeds, ABF final e_F(40) at the selected dt is >= 10 % lower than at dt 5e-4 with the 95 % bootstrap CI of the (unpaired, median-ratio) difference excluding 0. Stage-A failure without the ABF improvement = 'discretisation error present but not limiting'.
classification_rules.B_genuine_FR_acceleration: at the selected dt: median Delta I_F <= -10 % AND 95 % CI upper < 0 (97.5 % for the secondary rate), AND safety: Delta D_cond(T) CI upper <= +10 %, median final ancestor ESS/N >= 0.5, median max ancestor fraction <= 0.05
classification_rules.C_FR_inactive: median total replacements < 0.5 N over the run at that rate
classification_rules.D_FR_harmful: Delta I_F 95 % CI lower > 0, or genealogy unsafe (ESS/N < 0.5 or max fraction > 0.05), in particular together with a lower KL(p_hat || U) (more uniform marginal, worse free energy)
classification_rules.equivalence: TOST with margin +-10 %: the 90 % bootstrap CI of Delta I_F inside (-10 %, +10 %) -> 'equivalent to ABF'
classification_rules.E_discovery_or_conditional_limited: at the selected dt ABF's confirmatory e_F(40) exceeds 5x the Stage-A stationary discretisation error D_MF (the remaining error is sampling, not numerics); discovery-limited if the median under-supported window fraction at T > 0.10 or a torsional family is first discovered after t = 10 in at least half of the seeds; conditional-limited if support is adequate (fraction <= 0.10, families found by t = 10) while D_cond(T) of ABF stays >= 0.2
classification_rules.F_inconclusive: no ADMISSIBLE dt, or the 95 % CI of Delta I_F straddles both -10 % and 0 without satisfying TOST
classification_rules.coexistence: several categories may hold at once and all that hold are reported
